prompt: A monumental classic rubber duck in a warm amber-green Xbox-green lacquered finish, posed as the sole centerpiece in a vast dark cinematic space. The duck stands on an unseen floor against a seamless backdrop in #0B0B0C near-black tone with a faint warm vignette. Identical classic rubber duck silhouette across the entire collection: rounded teardrop body, short upturned beak, small webbed feet, plain oval pupil with no decorative glint. Camera placed low and three-quarter to read the duck as towering and reverent. A single hard key light from upper-left carves the form, while a strong cool rim light from behind-right separates the silhouette from the blackness, producing a sharp specular streak along the crown, shoulder, and beak. The lacquered surface reads glossy and resin-like with subtle bloom on the brightest highlights. A faint volumetric beam descends from above. No props, no UI chrome, no text. The atmosphere is museum-vitrine and theatrical, a single object commanding the void. 16:9 cinematic widescreen frame, sharp focus front-to-back, no motion blur.
